chapter.verse: Hih banga na thu genna uh tawh kisai-in Vanglianpen Topa in hong dawng a, “Ka pai nading lampi a bawl khol dingin ka kamtaipa ka sawl ding hi. Tua ciangin na ngakngak uh Topa a biakinn sungah thakhat thu-in hong pai ding hi. Na muh nop uh kamtaipa hong pai-in ka thuciamna hong taangko ding hi,” a ci hi.
Ahi zongin ama hong pai ni ciangin kua in thuak zo ding a, amah hong kilat ciangin kua nungta zo ding ahi hiam? Amah in, sikte a siangthosak mei, leh puante a siangthosak satpiang tawh kibang hi.

A ninte kangtumsakin, ngunte a siangsakpa bangin thukhen dingin hong pai ding hi. Ngun leh khamte a kisian’sak bangin amah in Levi’ suan-le-khak ahi siampite siangsak ding hi. Tua ciangin Topa tungah a kilawm biakna pia ding uh hi.
Tua ciangin Judah mite leh Jerusalem mite’ piak biaknate pen, nidang-ate mah bangin Topa ’ mai-ah a lungkimhuai hi ding hi.

Vanglianpen Topa in hih bangin ci hi: “Note tungah thukhen dingin ka hong pai ding a, ai tawite, numei tawh mawhte, a man lopi-a teci pangte, nasemte’ thaman piakna ah khemna a zangte, meigong, tagah, leh gamdang mite a zawhthawh bawlte, leh kei hong zahtak lo mi khempeuhte’ lang khatah thakhatin teci pangin thu ka khen ding hi.
Keimah in Topa ka hi a, lungsim a kheel lo mi ka hi hi. No Jakob’ suan-le-khakte aw, a sia cimit na hi nai kei uh hi.

Note in, na pu na pate uh mah bangin ka thukhamte panin na pialkhia uh a, ka thukhamte na zui kei uh hi. Ahi zongin keima lamah hong kihei kik un; kei zong note lamah kong kihei ding hi. Ahi zongin note in, ‘Nang lamah kong kihei nadingun bang hih ding ka hi uh hiam?’ na ci uh hi.

Keimah in note kong dot nop thu in, mi khatpeuh in Pasian’ na a guksak ding kilawm ahi hiam? Kilawm lo hi napi-in note in nong guksak uh hi. Ahi zongin note in, ‘Bang hong guksak ka hi uh hiam?’ na ci uh hi. Sawm-ah khat piakna leh biak piaknate ah nong guksak uh hi.
Na minam bup-un keima neihsa hong guksak na hih manun note khempeuh tungah samsiatna hong tung hi.
Ka biakinn ah an a om theih nadingin sawm-ah khat a kimin hong paipih un. Kei hong ze-et dih un; vantung kongkhakte hongin, note’ adingin na hoih tampi kong piakna na mu ding uh hi.
Lo panin a piang na ante uh, kauphe ka nesak nawn kei ding a, na leenggui uh gah pha mahmah ding hi.
Tua ciangin na gam uh, ten’ nadingin a hoih mahmah leitang hong suak ding ahih manin, minam dang khempeuh in note pen a nuamsa minam, hong ci ding uh hi,” Vanglianpen Pasian in a ci hi.
Topa in hih bangin ci hi: “Kei tawh kisai-in na kam paunate uh khauh mahmah hi. Note in, ‘Bang kam pau ka hi uh hiam?’ na ci uh hi.
Note in, ‘Pasian’ na i sep a mawkna hi. Ama hong sawl bangin i sep hangin bang a kiman’na om a, i gamtatnasate hangin i dahna lim, Vanglianpen Topa ’ mai-ah i lah hangin bang phattuamna om ahi hiam?

I muhna bang leh, mi kiphasak teng mah in thupha ngahin nuamsa uh hi. Mi gamtatsiate ahih leh cithei bek loin, a gamtat siatnate uh tawh Pasian ze-et napi-un bangmah tuak se lo uh hi,’ na ci uh hi,” a ci hi.

Topa a zahtak mite khat leh khat in tua bangin thu kigen uh a, amaute’ thugennate, Topa in ngai-in za hi. Topa in laibu khat nei a, amah zahtakin a thupi ngaihsut mite khempeuh tua sungah kiciamteh hi.

Topa in hih bangin ci hi: “Tua a kiciamteh mite pen keima mite hi ding uh hi. Keimah in na ka sep ni ciangin, amaute in keima neihtuam taktak mite hi ding uh hi. Pa in ama thu a mang a tapa a hehpih mah bangin, kei zong amaute ka hehpih ding hi.
Tua ciangin, midikte leh migilote, leh keima na hong semte leh hong sem lote a kilamdan’na na mu kik ding uh hi,” a ci hi.
